title: Over 80% of This Bird's Diet Is Bone. Here's How It Gets It Down
subject: bearded vulture

scenes.text: Eighty percent of this bird's diet is bone. How does it get it down?
The bearded vulture swallows bones up to thirty centimeters long, about a foot, whole.
Anything bigger, it carries high up and drops onto the rocks.
The bone shatters. Then it eats the pieces, and the fatty marrow inside.
A highly acidic stomach does the rest, breaking down what's left.
Wingspan nearly ten feet. The only bird on Earth that lives mostly on skeletons.

description:
Over eighty percent of the bearded vulture's diet is bone.
It swallows bones up to 30 cm whole and drops bigger ones onto rocks to smash them open.
Would you try a diet like that?
first_comment: It's also called the lammergeier. Would you rather watch it drop a bone or see it swallow one whole?
